title: High-Velocity Transfer Friction & Velocity Controls Policy
content: Velocity Controls Policy: Rapid successive outgoing transfers from a retail account represent elevated risk for malware drain and mule accounts. If more than 3 transactions occur within 10 minutes, or if identical amount transfers occur within 5 minutes, step-up two-factor simulation is engaged. Transactions failing step-up checks are automatically aborted with status FAILED and recorded in the Fraud Center.

passages.text: Rapid transfer rules: Executing more than 3 transactions within 10 minutes or identical amount charges within 5 minutes triggers velocity friction controls and an automatic High severity alert.
Duplicate charges: Duplicate transaction attempts within a 5-minute window are marked as Potential Duplicate Payment and require operator validation.
